title: Bengals will not pick up Myles Murphy's fifth-year option

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bengals will not pick up Myles Murphy's fifth-year option
sources.description: Bengals director of player personnel Duke Tobin said earlier this week that the team was still determining whether or not they would exercise their option on defensive end Myles Murphy's contract for 2027 and deliberation time has now come to an end.
